title: Bronze dataset
description: A dataset as landed: at least one file, and an RO-Crate 1.3 crate recording its identifier, name, description, who uploaded it, when, its licence and the profiles it conforms to. Every dataset meets this profile, and others build on it with $ref. Profiles check the crate's root as frame.json lays it out: what it refers to is embedded, and additionalProperty is keyed by name.
